title: Queue implementation
description: Read a number of ENQUEUE and DEQUEUE commands. Print each value removed from the front of the FIFO queue.
constraints: DEQUEUE is only used when the queue is not empty.
inputFormat: The first line contains n. Each of the next n lines is ENQUEUE <value> or DEQUEUE.
outputFormat: Print each value removed by a DEQUEUE command on its own line.

testCases.input:
6
ENQUEUE -1
ENQUEUE 0
DEQUEUE
ENQUEUE 5
DEQUEUE
DEQUEUE
